purpose: Machine-readable rules for deciding whether a specific application revision may make a current Shine Defence badge claim.

states.rule: Release commit SHA and Defence-profile blob SHA exactly match the reviewed ledger entry.
Release commit matches the reviewed commit but the Defence-profile blob differs from the reviewed profile.
Application exists in the ledger but the release commit differs from the reviewed commit.
Application is not present in the reviewed ecosystem ledger.

badgeRule: Only reviewed_release may present Protected by Shine Defence as a current release claim. Other states may disclose the last reviewed commit but must not imply that a later or changed revision inherited certification.
nonClaims: A reviewed release is not claimed to be invulnerable.
A later commit is not unsafe merely because it is unreviewed.
This contract does not replace app-specific Defence tests or normal release verification.
